question: Israel x Iran ceasefire continues through August 31?
research:
I couldn't find any reported Israeli or Iranian strike that hit the other country's territory between the likely market start (about July 16) and August 15, 2026. Iran's July 22 attack on Jordan does not count: only fragments of interceptors fell in Eilat. The main risks before August 31 are the US-Iran deal window expiring around August 16-17 and Israel's stated wish to strike Iran's energy sites. Treat the "Yes" status as a negative finding from searching. Every page fetch was refused by the proxy, so all of this rests on search-result summaries, and I couldn't open the original pages.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL, only "a consensus of resolution sources" (Polymarket's usual approach). I couldn't open the Polymarket page or the aggregator copies of it.
- 2026-07-16: The Lines.com URL carries a "20260716" timestamp, which suggests the market was created around July 16. It described the contract as covering "the full 60-day Islamabad window." [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/politics/israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-throughptptpt-20260716224448963)

## 2. Current status
- I found no report of an Israeli strike on Iran, or an Iranian strike on Israel, between about July 16 and August 15. The question is not settled. The fighting since July 8 has mainly been between the US and Iran, with Israel left out.
- 2026-07-22: Iran fired missiles and drones at Aqaba, Jordan, aimed at US bases there. They were intercepted, mostly by Jordan and/or the US. Interceptor fragments fell in northern Eilat with no damage, and the IDF denied taking part in the interceptions. Debris doesn't count under the rules. [ynetnews](https://www.ynetnews.com/article/bkpgmsqnml), [Ahram](https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/573121.aspx)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-15: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon killed at least 11 people, the deadliest day there since the June ceasefire. Iran's foreign minister Araghchi blamed the US for renewed violence in the Strait of Hormuz. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/15/world/live-news/iran-war-trump), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/8/15/iran-war-live-trump-vows-to-make-hormuz-us-territory-pretty-soon)
- 2026-08-14: A new carrier group is heading to the Middle East to replace the USS Lincoln. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/14/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-08-13: The US says it can keep its blockade of Iran going "indefinitely," and Treasury Secretary Bessent promised measures "never been seen." Hormuz traffic remains low. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/13/world/live-news/iran-war-trump), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/8/13/iran-war-live-us-and-iran-exchange-opposing-claims-over-hormuz-control)
- 2026-07-30: The US launched a "heavy wave" of strikes on Iran after a five-night pause, in response to Iranian attacks on US forces in Jordan. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/30/us-launches-another-round-of-attacks-on-iran)
- 2026-07-28: Israel's defense minister Katz said "We very much want to strike Iran's energy targets - the US is not approving it at this time." He said the IDF has been told to stay ready to strike without US support. Netanyahu met Trump at the White House. [JNS](https://www.jns.org/news/israel-news/katz-israel-wants-to-hit-iranian-energy-targets-us-not-approving)
- 2026-07-08 to 07-10: The April US-Iran ceasefire collapsed over shipping, and Trump said "the Cease Fire is OVER." [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/10/trump-says-us-has-agreed-to-continue-iran-talks-but-ceasefire-over), [Fox](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/iran-war-oil-prices-07-10-26)
- 2026-06-17: The US and Iran signed the Islamabad Memorandum, which set a 60-day window. [CRS](https://www.congress.gov/crs-product/R48887)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-02-28: The war began with joint US-Israeli strikes on Iran. [Britannica](https://www.britannica.com/event/2026-Iran-war)
- Early April to June 7 (about 2 months): there were no direct Israel-Iran strikes under the truce.
- 2026-06-07 to 06-08: Iran and Israel exchanged strikes, the first since April. Both stopped within about a day after Trump told them to, and Israel reportedly held off at the US's request. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/8/iran-and-israel-bomb-each-other-is-the-ceasefire-over), [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-trump-israel-strikes-ceasefire-lebanon-beirut/)
- June 8 to August 15 (about 10 weeks): I found no direct Israel-Iran strike. That held even through heavy US-Iran fighting in July, when Iran aimed at US bases and Gulf/Jordan targets rather than Israel.
- In short, over about 4.5 months of truce there was one Israel-Iran exchange. That works out to roughly a 10-15% chance per 16-day window. This is my rough calculation, not a sourced figure.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-07-29: An aggregator snapshot showed "continues through August 31" at about 92.5% and the August 15 contract at about 99.65%. [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/3128787)
- One analysis said the price history reflected very thin trading, while other sources reported larger volumes for related markets. [octagonai](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/iran/israel/israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-through.md)
- I couldn't find a current (August 15) Polymarket price, or any Kalshi or Manifold equivalent.

## 6. Upcoming events before August 31
- Around 2026-08-16 to 08-17: the 60-day Islamabad Memorandum window ends (60 days from June 17), along with a US-Iran deal deadline.
- Mid-August 2026: Jared Kushner is travelling to Egypt and Israel this week. [ABC](https://abcnews.com/International/live-updates/iran-live-updates-negotiations-us-messages-exchanged-tehran/?id=135508900)
- Ongoing: possible US approval of Israeli strikes on Iran's energy sites (per Katz, July 28), and further US strikes and Iranian retaliation that could reach Israel.
- 2026-08-15: The Israel-Hezbollah escalation matters because Iran said in June it would resume attacks if Israel kept up hostilities, including in Lebanon. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/8/israel-and-iran-exchange-attacks-as-ceasefire-falters)
